provenance.method: GUI worker, real keyboard/pointer input (XTest, acknowledged relative drags), history read from the editor's undo list frames, geometry read by read-only layer queries between inputs
provenance.harness: private capture card (predictions committed before raw)

scenes.B0: unit cube (+-0.5) with the +Z and +X faces deleted, built directly (no handle drag): 8 v / 4 f / 11 e; subpatch ON; camera azimuth 215, elevation 25, distance 4

history_vocabulary.activation: one row when an interactive cutting tool is armed
history_vocabulary.adjustment: one row per pointer gesture inside the live tool session (press..release), including gestures that add no geometry
history_vocabulary.live_apply: one trailing apply row that stays LAST while the session is live; it becomes a fixed row when the session ends (tool switch, apply-and-rearm, any scripted/command block)

edge_slice_pending_segment_polygonal.input: edge slice; hover a second vertical edge with no point (baseline frame); click point 1 on edge x=+0.5,z=-0.5 at mid-height (no drag); hover the second edge x=-0.5,z=-0.5 at the baseline pixel, then 30 px lower
edge_slice_pending_segment_polygonal.law: no pending segment from the last point to the cursor on a polygonal mesh either: only the hovered target edge is highlighted (the subpatch cell edge_slice_pending_segment_subpatch shows the same)

edge_slice_undo_after_rearm.input: edge slice; point 1 on x=+0.5,z=-0.5 and point 2 on x=-0.5,z=-0.5 (short drags along the edges); shift+tap on empty viewport (apply and re-arm); click point 1 of a new chain on x=-0.5,z=+0.5; Ctrl+Z three times

undo_steps.effect: the new chain's point popped; tool stays active; the applied chain 1 is intact
the re-arm rows (point-count reset + live apply) popped; tool active; geometry unchanged
chain 1 popped as ONE step together with the activation; tool off

edge_slice_undo_after_rearm.law: after an apply-and-re-arm inside one activation, Ctrl+Z pops the new chain's points and keeps the tool armed with zero points (rule K1)

slice_redo_after_session_end.input: slice; line 1 across the model; a second drag at another height (re-defines the line); Ctrl+Z; Ctrl+Z (tool off); Ctrl+Shift+Z; Ctrl+Shift+Z

redo_steps.effect: tool re-armed WITH the first gesture: the line-1 cut, vertex positions identical to after_line1; rows activation, adjustment, live_apply
refused: out of redos (the re-arm truncated the redo stack; the second gesture is gone)

slice_redo_after_session_end.law: redo after the session-ending Ctrl+Z re-arms slice with its FIRST gesture and truncates the rest

loop_slice_undo_redo.scene: C0 with the faces -Z and -X selected (the tool acts on the selection; with no selection a gesture only moves the position slider)
loop_slice_undo_redo.input: loop slice (toolbox button); gesture 1 = short drag on edge x=+0.5,z=-0.5; gesture 2 = short drag on edge x=-0.5,z=+0.5; gesture 3 = 60 px horizontal drag on empty viewport; Ctrl+Z until the tool is off; Ctrl+Shift+Z twice

after_arm.effect: arming with a polygon selection ALREADY cuts one loop at the remembered position

after_gesture2.effect: an unchanged position is still its own row

undo_steps.effect: gesture 1 popped; the tool is STILL active with the arm-time loop

redo_steps.effect: tool re-armed BARE: the arm-time loop, NOT gesture 1 (0.405)

loop_slice_undo_redo.law: unlike slice / edge slice, the loop slice activation is its OWN undo step (it already cuts); Ctrl+Z pops gestures one by one, the step that pops the activation ends the tool, and redo re-arms bare (no gesture replayed)
